techs.desc: Unlocks City Invest, boosts spawn rates.

quests.desc: Drag hero to tree, chop 100 Pine Wood
Click to build Barracks, drag hero to build
Drag hero to rob, gain 100 Coins
Click Smithy in Market, buy 1 gear
Click any hero, equip gear
Click hero gear, upgrade level
Open left region panel, start next floor
Click hero [color=yellow]Level Up[/color] button
Click to build Academy, complete it
In Academy, select Desk
Click Desk, research Recruit, drag hero to tech
Click to build Recruit, complete it
At Recruit, recruit a hero
Click hero name above, deploy hero
Continue, clear Xuchang 5
Click to build Forge, complete it
Go to Armory, buy Firewood Axe Recipe
Craft 1 basic gear, need Anvil first
Sell 1 gear at Pawnshop in Market
Click Desk, research City Investment
Left panel or Lord Hall, click Invest
Continue, clear Xuchang 10
Click to build Assembly, complete it
Have 4+ Barracks for more heroes
Recruit 1 hero at Tavern
Change job of any hero once
Continue, clear Xuchang 20
Open world map, go to Ink Forest
Kill 100 monsters in Ink Forest
Click left to summon and defeat Nine-Tailed Fox
At Lord Hall, get <B-Spear> Recipe
Merge 1 set at Forge
Continue, clear Xuchang 30
Expand Hideout level at Assembly
Gather 1000 herbs in Ink Forest
Click to build Brew Lab, complete it
Get pill recipe at Lord Hall, then brew 1 pill
In hero Pills tab, use 1 Aptitude Pill
Continue, clear Xuchang 40
Go to Lord Hall, buy Greed Core Recipe
At Brew Lab, make 1 Core
Equip 1 Core like gear
Click to build Arena, complete it
Train Thug job at Post to Lv2
Continue, clear Xuchang 50
Open world map, go to Luoyang
Complete 1 Realm Ascend
